name: Payment Icons
summary: Passive native list of target-supplied recognized payment-method marks with informative names, semantic sizing, and intrinsic wrapping.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered list containing one or more valid payment-method items and an optional localized accessible name.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item for one recognized target-supplied payment method.

anatomy.name: mark
anatomy.description: Approved raster, vector, or target-native payment-method mark with a brief accessible method name.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One passive treatment that preserves target brand artwork.

sizes.name: sm
sizes.description: Compact 1.125rem mark block size for dense supporting contexts.

states.name: default
states.description: Populated passive collection with no focus, hover, live-region, motion, controlled state, or neutral runtime.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
attributes: role="list" when marker removal would otherwise weaken list exposure
behavior.description: The collection uses native ul/li semantics, preserves target source order, and adds no widget role or keyboard model.

behavior.name: informativeMarks
attributes: non-empty alt for informative img marks
role="img" and an accessible name for informative inline SVG marks
target-native accessibilityLabel or equivalent for native marks
behavior.description: Every valid mark communicates its recognized payment-method name without relying on color, hover, or surrounding brand inference.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Targets omit unnamed or invalid marks and their items, and omit the complete root when no valid method remains.

behavior.name: intrinsicWrapping
behavior.description: Items wrap from the component content box without viewport queries, visual reordering, clipping, or Studio-only layout repair.

behavior.name: targetDataOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own current availability, provider/region/currency eligibility, order, official assets, licenses, brand rules, localization, and publication.

properties.name: icons
properties.description: One or more target-owned native list-item compositions containing a recognized informative payment-method mark and its accessible name.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Default or Small mark presentation density.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-label when surrounding visible context already identifies the accepted payment methods.
properties.description: Optional localized accessible list name used only when surrounding visible context does not already identify the methods.

accessibility: Render the collection as a native ul/li list, preserving target source order and adding role=list only as a marker-removal exposure safeguard.
Require every mark to expose a brief recognized payment-method name through alt, named image semantics, or the target-native equivalent.
Omit unnamed or invalid marks/items and omit the complete root when no valid payment method remains.
Use an optional localized accessibleLabel only when surrounding visible context does not already identify the collection.
Do not add focus stops, controls, widget roles, hover-only disclosure, live regions, keyboard behavior, motion, controlled state, or neutral runtime to passive marks.
Do not grayscale, recolor, reduce the opacity of, or otherwise override approved target brand artwork.
Leave current availability, eligibility, order, official assets, licensing, brand rules, localization, and publication with the target.

web.notes: Implemented as a conditionally rendered native list with named informative marks, semantic size, intrinsic wrapping, preserved brand treatment, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated snippet consumes supplied types or shop.enabled_payment_types and maps official payment_type_svg_tag output to the canonical native-list class contract with a localized list label and zero component JavaScript.
